title: Deterministic PreCompact Context Preservation & Episodic Memory Snapshot Hook
target_platform: macOS / APM Lifecycle Hooks (PreCompact) for Claude Code, Codex & AGY
hypothesis: Configuring an APM PreCompact lifecycle hook (.apm/hooks/hooks.json) that triggers automatically prior to context compaction captures uncommitted scratch conclusions, extracts session friction, and persists a provisional memory snapshot to Layer 2/3 before context amnesia occurs, preserving continuity with under 2,500ms execution latency.
falsification_criteria: A context compaction event occurs without invoking the hook, the hook fails to record an uncommitted session trace to memory, or execution latency exceeds 2,500ms.
baseline_evidence: MISSION-024 established deterministic SessionStart lifecycle hooks in plugins/sanctuary-core/.apm/hooks/hooks.json with 544.6ms average startup latency and reliable Layer 1 hydration.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if cross-platform lifecycle hook specification requires multi-agent orchestration.

evidence.details: PreCompact handler: median 61 ms, max 67 ms over 30 runs on a 20.6 MB transcript (ceiling 2500 ms); snapshot lists uncommitted files, last conclusions and friction; planted secrets redacted; exits 0 on malformed input and outside a Sanctuary checkout; fired on a real manual /compact in a scratch Claude Code session (18 ms). LIMIT: the auto (context-full) trigger was not exercised, and the hook runs only where the plugin hooks are installed.

lessons_learned: A hook that can block compaction is worse than none: always exit 0, print nothing.
Test hook firing for real with a throwaway session and --settings, not only by simulating the payload.
Codex can write a passing test file from a spec, but extraction of its output needs care (log lines leak into captured output).

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
